findings.description: The bucket is explicitly indicated as public and has no private ACL, public-access-block configuration, or restrictive bucket policy in this configuration. Objects such as the customer master spreadsheet may therefore be exposed to unauthenticated internet access.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined for this bucket, so stored objects are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest under an explicitly managed policy.
Despite the private ACL, the financials bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, leaving financial data unprotected at rest by an explicitly enforced encryption setting.
The operations bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning does not provide confidentiality for objects or their retained versions.
The data-science bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so its data is not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest by the bucket configuration.
